verdict.rationale: Capacities documents a REST API (Bearer/OAuth2 auth) for creating/manipulating content and an MCP client integration path for building bots/agents, which developers could use to build integrations, but there is no documented 'plugin' architecture with extension hooks into the app UI, no plugin manifest system, and no sample plugin code or plugin-specific SDK/starter templates. missing for 10: dedicated plugin/extension SDK with UI hook points, sample plugin repos or starter templates, plugin packaging/marketplace docs, independent developer corroboration of building a working plugin.
